mapper.insert: INSERT INTO common.refresh_token ( account_no, token_hash, expires_at, created_at, is_revoked ) VALUES ( #{accountNo, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.AccountNoTypeHandler}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.CreatedAtTypeHandler}, NOW()), COALESCE(#{isRevoked}, FALSE) )
mapper.select: SELECT token_id AS tokenId, account_no AS accountNo, token_hash AS tokenHash, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_at AS createdAt, is_revoked AS isRevoked FROM common.refresh_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.update: UPDATE common.refresh_token SET is_revoked = TRUE WHERE account_no = #{accountNo} AND is_revoked = FALSE
UPDATE common.refresh_token SET is_revoked = TRUE WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND is_revoked = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM common.refresh_token WHERE expires_at < NOW()
